title: Make the hands good by what they serve
summary: Hands become good when they help praise take form in the world. Let conduct answer before performance does.
takeaway: Let conduct answer before performance does.
lifeApplication: Before speaking about values again, ask what your treatment of people showed today and choose the cleaner act.

source.shortMeaning: Hands become good when they help praise take form in the world.
source.lifeApplication: Before the next task, ask whether your hands are serving praise or vanity.

evidence.coreClaim: Hands become good when they help praise take form in the world.
evidence.turn: Let speech, sight, hands, and feet become honorable through praise.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before speaking about values again, ask what your treatment of people showed today and choose the cleaner act.
